name: tia-portal-mcp-read
description: Inspect locally installed TIA Portal projects without changing project data.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to a locally installed TIA Portal. The broker detects installed versions and starts a matching bundled read worker. Project mutation tools are not included.

tia_version.title: TIA Portal version
tia_version.description: Use auto when exactly one supported version is installed, or enter V17, V18, V19 or V20.
